`enum EventPriority`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [EventPriority.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/EventPriority.java)

The order in which the listeners of one event run, from `HIGHEST` to `LOWEST`, then `MONITOR`.

## Description

Listeners of the same priority run in the order they were added.
Once a listener cancels or consumes the event, the listeners after it do not run, except the `MONITOR` ones.

- [Events](/use/learn/interactivity/events/#order-the-listeners-of-one-event)

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`HIGHEST`](#EventPriority-value-HIGHEST) | Runs before every other listener. |
| [`HIGH`](#EventPriority-value-HIGH) | Runs after `HIGHEST`, before `NORMAL`. |
| [`NORMAL`](#EventPriority-value-NORMAL) | The priority of a plain lambda. |
| [`LOW`](#EventPriority-value-LOW) | Runs after `NORMAL`, before `LOWEST`. |
| [`LOWEST`](#EventPriority-value-LOWEST) | Runs after every other listener that can change the event. |
| [`MONITOR`](#EventPriority-value-MONITOR) | Runs last, even after a cancel or a consume, and only reads: `cancel()` or `consume()` there throws an `IllegalStateException`. |

<a id="EventPriority-value-MONITOR"></a>

### MONITOR

`MONITOR` 

Runs last, even after a cancel or a consume, and only reads: `cancel()` or `consume()` there throws an `IllegalStateException`.
Use it to log or count what happened.
